purpose.domain_detail: Music album data migration utility — synchronises a VSAM KSDS file to a DB2 table (ALBUM)
purpose.summary: Batch program VSAMTODB reads records sequentially from a VSAM KSDS file (ALBUM-KSDS) and synchronises them into a DB2 table (API5.ALBUM) using a cursor-based merge algorithm. It handles insert, delete, and update scenarios by comparing VSAM and DB2 keys (CODEA), and clears the table entirely if the VSAM file is empty.

notable_features: EXEC SQL embedded DB2 (INCLUDE SQLCA, INCLUDE ALBUM, DECLARE CURSOR, OPEN/FETCH/CLOSE CURSOR, INSERT, DELETE)
VSAM KSDS sequential access via FILE-CONTROL SELECT with RECORD KEY
88-level condition names for end-of-file and end-of-table indicators
Merge/sync logic comparing VSAM key vs DB2 cursor key
COPY ALBUM copybook for file record layout
verdict.notes: Program appears to be a student or training exercise (author CHRISEDR, date 24/10/23, French comments, simplified merge with CONTINUE placeholders) but is structured in a production-like style. The main PERFORM UNTIL loop has some incomplete branches (CONTINUE stubs for modify/create/delete cases). No COMP-3 usage despite numeric fields. Overall confidence is high that this is genuine IBM mainframe COBOL with DB2.
